I found 8 new candidates for 2025 that aren't on your recorded list. I read every quote below on a page I opened. One of them, the Wall Street Journal line, I only saw in a news article that quotes the Journal. I didn't open the Journal itself.

**New candidates**
- **His essay "Seemingly Conscious AI is Coming" (19 August 2025, on his own site).** He wrote that an AI that seems conscious can be built with today's technology plus some "that will mature over the next 2-3 years."
- **Moonshots podcast (published 16 December 2025, recorded 5 December).** On agents, he said "in the next couple of years, those things come into view and they're going to be very, very good." The podscripts transcript doesn't say who is speaking. It reads as Suleyman, since the host then sums it up as agents passing his "modern Turing test" by 2027.
- **Big Technology podcast (12 November 2025).** He called a self-improving AI "takeoff" that replaces humans "very low probability" but something to "take seriously in the next like 10 years or so." This is a warning about a risk more than a forecast that it will happen.
- **Silicon Valley Girl podcast (14 November 2025), three lines.** All three came after the host said "Imagine it's 2040," which is a hypothetical setup. I kept them because his own words name a date or span:
  - an AI in your ear with ambient awareness: "by 2040, definitely"
  - "we'll definitely have self-driving cars by 2040"
  - a home robot that "probably will be humanoid," because "15 years is a pretty long way out"
- **Wall Street Journal, about 20 July 2025, news coverage only.** VideoAge quotes the Journal quoting him: "Soon to me is sometime in the next ten years." VideoAge links it to super-intelligence or AGI, but I couldn't check the original wording. The point is close to the recorded April claim that AGI is "a decade or so away," but it's a different occasion.

**Already recorded claims I came across:** human-level performance on most tasks in five years, computing "much more ambient in five to 10 years", and knowledge and companions at zero marginal cost "in a decade."

**Left out:** company plans ("over the next two or three years… build out one of the top labs", selling agents "in five years time"), economic remarks (value "in the next five to 10 years", a "10, 20 year lag" before services get cheaper), and lines with no set date ("in a few years' time… closed loop").

**Searches:** I ran all 12 searches and opened 5 of the 6 pages allowed. Most of the "18 months for white-collar automation" coverage traces to a Financial Times interview that seems to be from early 2026, so I listed it under other years.
